purpose: Design document defining an output contract for parallel agents so shared-resource write races cannot occur, by returning results as return values to the orchestrator.
summary: Problem of concurrent writes to shared files by parallel agents in Claude Code
Scope: contract covers result handoff to the orchestrator, not editing by writer agents
Basic principle: agents return results as return values, not via shared resources
No intermediate files or session directories for result handoff
Responsibilities of agents and orchestrator, including partial failure handling
Application example: context gathering with specs, rules, and code agents
Anti-patterns: shared file writes, read-modify-write, file locks, intermediate files
Checklist for designing new parallel agents
tasks: Choosing between return values and files
Avoiding race conditions in agent workflows
title: DES-022 並列 agent 出力契約パターン 設計書
